name: – Stéphanie Yon-Courtin – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the impact of the implementation of Directive 2014/89/EU, the Maritime Spatial Planning Directive, on fisheries in selected fishing areas and sea basins
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how EU countries plan the use of their seas. It says planning has been uneven and has not helped fishing much. Fishing and fish farming lose space to wind farms, shipping and protected areas. The Parliament asks for fishing to be treated as a priority use of the sea, for fishers to be properly consulted, for better data, and for the planning rules to be revised under the upcoming Ocean Act.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its position and calls for changes.
- **Who it affects:** Fishers, fish and shellfish farmers, coastal communities, and EU and national authorities.
- **What happens next:** The European Commission is asked to revise the planning rules in the Ocean Act, expected in late 2026.
